risk_description: Retrofit gains may raise housing costs or displacement pressure without tenant protections
Reverse logistics may increase transport burden or energy use if poorly designed
Mobility investments may increase neighborhood desirability without affordability protections
Repair ecosystem may depend on underpaid or informal labor
Procurement metrics may reward nominal circularity while missing lifecycle or labor harms
Green infrastructure may fail if maintenance ownership and funding are weak
Water reuse adoption may fail if trust
Electrification costs may shift to tenants or trigger rent increases
